name: Fake SSB
description: Artificial scroll speed bug at chosen level percentages, configurable from the pause menu.

ssb-enabled.name: Enable
ssb-enabled.description: Turn the artificial SSB on or off.

ssb-method.name: Method
ssb-method.description: Shape = stretch/squeeze the horizontal movement. Speed = speed up / slow down the whole player.

t1-start.name: Start %
t1-start.description: Level percent where the effect starts.

t1-end.name: End %
t1-end.description: Level percent where the effect ends.

t1-speed.name: Speed %
t1-speed.description: 100 = normal, above = faster / stretched, below = slower / squeezed, 0 = frozen.
